context: Tests whether the frontend dev skill drives agents toward a canonical verify entrypoint and delivery documentation before changing automation.

checklist.name: runs_repo_inspection_first
checklist.description: Starts by inspecting package scripts, Makefile, GitHub workflows, docs, env examples, and delivery-related references before editing.

checklist.name: creates_canonical_verify_entrypoint
checklist.description: Recommends one repo-local `verify` command that CI calls directly, rather than duplicating build/test logic only in GitHub Actions.

checklist.name: stabilizes_verify_before_delivery
checklist.description: Says to run and fix the local verify command before changing publish or deploy automation.

checklist.name: documents_distribution_contract
checklist.description: Places release, publishing, or deployment contract details in `docs/DISTRIBUTION.md` with contributor docs linking to it when needed.

checklist.name: names_smoke_or_gap
checklist.description: Requires an artifact/app/proof smoke check after delivery changes, or explicitly records the missing smoke check as a repo gap.
